name: Qubit Pharmaceuticals
description: Qubit Pharmaceuticals accelerates drug discovery through molecular simulation powered by hybrid HPC and quantum computing. Spun out of research at Sorbonne University, CNRS, and CNAM, the company's Atlas platform models molecular interactions at quantum-level accuracy, and has demonstrated a practical path to quantum utility in drug discovery by 2028.

news.title: Qubit Pharmaceuticals announces strategic collaboration with Singapore's Centre for Quantum Technologies to advance quantum algorithms for drug discovery
news.excerpt: Strategic research collaboration to develop novel quantum algorithms for molecular discovery, combining Qubit Pharmaceuticals' expertise in quantum chemistry with CQT's capabilities in quantum computing and experimental implementation.

news.title: Qubit Pharmaceuticals Announces Dual Breakthroughs: Quantum Speedup and 2028 Utility Path for Drug Discovery
news.excerpt: Qubit Pharmaceuticals announced two simultaneous milestones: a collaboration with Sorbonne University published in Nature Communications demonstrating quantum algorithms can surpass theoretical speed limits for non-reversible Markov chains, and a preprint with Q-CTRL establishing a timeline for quantum utility in drug discovery by 2028.

news.title: Qubit Pharmaceuticals, Sorbonne Universite and Q-CTRL demonstrate 3D protein hydration-site prediction on IBM Heron processors
news.excerpt: Researchers from Qubit Pharmaceuticals, Sorbonne Universite (CNRS Laboratoire de Chimie Theorique) and Q-CTRL recast water-site prediction in protein pockets as a QUBO problem and ran it on IBM Heron processors at up to 123 qubits across five drug-target structures. On 11 instances of 41 to 116 qubits the solver matched CPLEX-verified optimal placements; the authors estimate competitiveness with leading classical tools at roughly 900 qubits. The work is published in Physical Review Research.

news.title: Sorbonne Universite and Qubit Pharmaceuticals introduce VULCAN hybrid framework for quantum chemistry
news.excerpt: VULCAN is a hybrid quantum-classical electronic-structure framework aimed at the gradient-measurement bottleneck of ADAPT-VQE. In the reported benchmarks its operator pools were 4x to 25x smaller than QEB pools and reached chemical accuracy with 5% to 20% of the measurements of batched ADAPT-VQE; a proof-of-principle run on a Quantinuum H2 processor measured the H2 ground-state energy within 1.7e-3 Ha of the exact reference (arXiv:2610.40561).
